description.en: Adds one item to the workspace menu that moves a workspace to the top of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar once, through the host workspace registry. No favorites, pins, stars, automatic reordering or startup re-sorting.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 工作区的「…」菜单里加一项「移到最上面」，通过宿主 workspace 注册表只调整一次顺序。没有收藏、固定置顶、星标、自动重排或启动重排。
